title: Design System: Rosia & Piotrek — Wedding Gallery

display.purpose: The wordmark and the page-owning title. One per page, flush left, high in the frame, with a 2rem ink rule beneath.

headline.purpose: The section that owns the rest of the page, such as the gallery heading.

title.purpose: A well's own heading: upload panel, photo challenge, empty-state invitation, admin row.

numeral.purpose: Counts, totals and positions set as real serif figures with tabular numerics.

body.purpose: All running prose. Long-form capped at a 65ch measure.

label.purpose: Marginal annotation naming a value, a field or a status. Never a kicker above a heading.

action.purpose: Control type only: uppercase, tracked, 500 weight.

corners.name: ma-scoop
corners.purpose: The control-scale scoop. Applied as border-radius + corner-shape: scoop to .ma-action, .ma-field, .ma-stage-action and .ma-stage-field, only inside @supports (corner-shape: scoop). Without the property no radius is ever seen and the corner stays square.

corners.name: ma-scoop-plane
corners.purpose: The plane-scale scoop. Applied the same guarded way to .ma-plane and .ma-empty. Photographs, thumbnails and the placed plate take no corner treatment at all.

shadows.name: stage-control-legibility
shadows.purpose: Night side only. Holds chrome legible directly on a guest's photograph so no pill or scrim is needed. Never a resting elevation, never used on the plaster world.

motion.name: ma-ease
motion.purpose: The world's one easing, used by every transition and animation.

motion.name: ma-place-ms
motion.purpose: The authored placement moment: a chosen photograph settles onto the bronze plane from scale(0.94) translateY(1.25rem) blur(6px).

motion.name: alcove-in
motion.purpose: The ink-deep scrim fading the arrangement back behind a placed photograph.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Colour and border-colour transitions on actions and fields. Nothing moves or scales.

motion.name: slide-in
motion.purpose: Night-side slide entry from blur(12px) scale(1.02).

textures.name: plaster
textures.purpose: The alcove wall. Deterministic seeded value-noise tile authored at 512px by scripts/make-textures.mjs (base 239, amplitude 3.5, 5 octaves, seed 20260620). Set as the surface, not screened over a flat field.

textures.name: bronze
textures.purpose: The suiban base plane. Same generator, coarser patina (base 42, amplitude 5.5, 4 octaves, seed 19940317).

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The reversed ink block. The one committed action in a well; everything else there is the hairline outline.
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; min-height: 3rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding-inline: 1.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--ma-ink, #1a1a1a); background: var(--ma-ink, #1a1a1a); color: var(--ma-plaster-lit, #f7f7f7); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-action:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--ma-ink-deep, #0a0a0a); border-color: var(--ma-ink-deep, #0a0a0a); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ma-ink, #1a1a1a); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-action:disabled { border-color: var(--ma-ash, #d8d8d8); background: transparent; color: var(--ma-disabled, #767676); cursor: not-allowed; } @supports (corner-shape: scoop) { .ds-action { border-radius: var(--ma-scoop, 0.5rem); corner-shape: scoop; } }

components.name: Ghost Action
components.description: The same box unfilled. Hover inverts it into the filled ink block, so rest and commitment are visibly the same object.
components.css: .ds-action-ghost { display: inline-flex; min-height: 3rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.625rem; padding-inline: 1.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--ma-ink, #1a1a1a); background: transparent; color: var(--ma-ink, #1a1a1a); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-action-ghost:hover { background: var(--ma-ink, #1a1a1a); color: var(--ma-plaster-lit, #f7f7f7); } .ds-action-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ma-ink, #1a1a1a); outline-offset: 3px; } @supports (corner-shape: scoop) { .ds-action-ghost { border-radius: var(--ma-scoop, 0.5rem); corner-shape: scoop; } }

components.name: Danger Action
components.description: Destruction is available, never loud. At rest an underlined oxblood word; it takes its box and its fill only once the pointer or focus commits.
components.css: .ds-action-danger { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding-inline: 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--ma-oxblood, #8c2318); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ma-oxblood, #8c2318) 40%, transparent); text-underline-offset: 0.35em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-action-danger:hover, .ds-action-danger:focus-visible { background: var(--ma-oxblood, #8c2318); border-color: var(--ma-oxblood, #8c2318); color: var(--ma-plaster-lit, #f7f7f7); text-decoration-color: transparent; } @supports (corner-shape: scoop) { .ds-action-danger { border-radius: var(--ma-scoop, 0.5rem); corner-shape: scoop; } }

components.name: Hairline Field
components.description: The alcove's text input: a box drawn in one stroke on paper white. Focus doubles the hairline instead of glowing.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-field">Hasło zaproszenia</label><input id="ds-field" class="ds-field" type="text" placeholder="np. wianki-2026" />

components.name: Lifted Plane
components.description: There are no cards, only planes: one step lighter than the wall, inside a 1px ash rule, scooped at the plane depth, no shadow. Shown here with the heading and its ranking rule.
components.html:
Dorzuć swoje zdjęcia

Do 10 plików naraz, każdy do 25 MiB. Nie zapisujemy Twojego imienia.

components.name: Charged Empty State
components.description: An empty state is a composed invitation, so it keeps the full field of the thing it is waiting for instead of collapsing to a line.
components.html:
Jeszcze nikt nic nie wrzucił.

Bądź pierwszy — zdjęcia pojawią się tutaj po zatwierdzeniu.

components.name: Struck Counts
components.description: The supporting line: live counts set as real serif numerals with tabular figures, each under a tracked caps label. The label names a value — it is never a kicker above a heading.

narrative.overview:
This is an alcove, not a page. The wall is plaster, the base plane is a dark bronze suiban, and every screen is an arrangement of three lines — a primary line (the wordmark), a supporting line (the thanks and the struck counts), and a secondary line (the well you act in) — with the emptiness between them left charged and deliberately empty. The system's entire job is to hold a guest's photograph and get out of its way, so the interface removed its own colour: every interface token is achromatic (R = G = B), and the photographs guests upload are the only live colour on screen.

The world's one accent was translated rather than dropped. Where the alcove used iris blue, this interface reverses the ink: a committed action is a filled ink block with plaster type, and at rest that same control is only a hairline outline. Depth is made of two materials and nothing else — a 1px ash rule, and the dark bronze ground that anchors every light field. No corner is rounded: where the browser supports it, a corner is a scoop cut into the plane, and everywhere else it stays square. Nothing casts a decorative shadow. The one authored motion moment is placement: choosing a photograph recedes the arrangement and sets that photograph over the bronze plane, 420ms, once.

The night side (/pokaz, the projected slideshow) is the same world with its planes inverted — ink ground, plaster type, photograph still the only colour in the room. It is not a second theme and must never be styled as one.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic interface; exactly three tinted inks, reserved for error, success, and warning
The cut corner: a concave scoop (0.5rem on controls, 0.875rem on planes) that degrades to the square edge, never to a round one
Hairline 1px rules and a dark bronze base instead of shadows
Instrument Serif set large with tight negative leading, upright only
Asymmetric three-line arrangements with composed, load-bearing voids
One authored motion moment (placement), instantly cut under reduced motion

rules.name: The Achromatic Room Rule
rules.body: Every interface colour satisfies R = G = B. Exactly three tinted values exist in the system — oxblood for error, bottle for success, amber for warning — and test/contrast.test.ts fails the build the moment a fourth hex with unequal channels appears in app/globals.css. A new accent is not a design decision here; it is a broken build.

rules.name: The Only Colour Rule
rules.body: The guests' photographs are the only other colour on screen. Never tint a surface, an icon, a chart, or a state chip to compete with them.

rules.name: The Reversed Ink Rule
rules.body: The active accent is a filled ink block with plaster type. Exactly one filled block is live at a time in a given well; every other control in that well is the hairline outline at rest. Two filled blocks side by side means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Never An Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The label style is a marginal annotation, never a kicker above a heading. It names a value, a field, or a status. A small tracked caps line sitting directly above a display heading is a violation of this system, not an instance of it.

rules.name: The Upright Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif ships upright only. There is no italic in this world; emphasis is size, position, or the rule beneath.

rules.name: The Struck Fact Rule
rules.body: Numbers that are facts — counts, totals, positions — are set in the serif with tabular figures, never in the body sans.

rules.name: The Anchored Base Rule
rules.body: Every page closes on the bronze plane — either a full suiban footer or the 0.75rem base bar. A light field that ends without a dark plane beneath it is floating, and floating is wrong.

rules.name: The Hairline Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is the rule and the ground, never a shadow. If a surface needs to feel raised, give it the lit plane and a 1px ash stroke; if it needs to feel anchored, put bronze underneath it.

rules.name: The Structural Rule Rule
rules.body: The 2rem ink rule ranks a heading. It is structure, not ornament — never a decorative divider between sections, and never centred. The full-width ash rule is the only rule allowed to separate.

rules.name: The Utilities Win Rule
rules.body: Every ma-* class is defined inside @layer components on purpose, so a Tailwind utility always overrides it. Compose by putting the component class first and adjusting with utilities; never fight it with !important.

rules.name: The One Authored Moment Rule
rules.body: Placement is the only motion this system authors. Everything else is a 160ms colour transition from an already-visible default, and reduced motion cuts placement to an instant. A second animated moment was built once, for the upload confirmation, and removed: two authored moments is none.

dos: Do keep every new interface colour achromatic (R = G = B) and pull it from the existing ramp; test/contrast.test.ts is the audit.
Do reserve oxblood (#8c2318), bottle (#1e4d2b), and amber (#6b4a00) for error, success, and warning respectively, and use them as ink — on type or as a fill under plaster-lit type.
Do put exactly one filled ink block in a well; every other control there is the hairline outline.
Do close every page on the bronze plane — a ma-suiban footer or the 0.75rem ma-base bar.
Do rank a heading with the 2rem ink rule and compose the line beneath it off-axis, using column starts rather than centring.
Do set counts, totals, and positions in the serif with tabular figures.
Do give every interactive element a visible focus treatment that clears AA — the ink (or plaster, on the night side) outline at 3px offset, and the doubled hairline on fields.
Do author new texture as a deterministic seeded tile through scripts/make-textures.mjs so a clean checkout can regenerate it.
donts: Don't add a rounded corner anywhere. The only radius in the system lives inside @supports (corner-shape: scoop), where it is what the scoop cuts into; a radius outside that query is a round corner, and the build fails on it.
Don't scoop a photograph, a thumbnail or the placed plate. The corner treatment belongs to the interface, and the interface does not cut into a guest's image.

Don't introduce a shadow for elevation. Use the lit plane plus an ash hairline, or the bronze ground. The only shadow in the system is the night-side legibility drop-shadow on chrome sitting over a photograph.
Don't set a small tracked-caps line above a heading. The label is a marginal annotation for a value, a field, or a status — never a kicker or eyebrow.
Don't centre a display heading or a page's primary line; the arrangement is asymmetric and flush left.
Don't use the 2rem rule as a decorative divider between sections, and don't ornament a section break at all — the full-width ash rule or a dark plane does that work.
Don't set body text in Instrument Serif, and don't introduce an italic; the face ships upright only.
Don't put an even grid of equal tiles under the photographs; the feed is a masonry column flow so photographs keep their proportion.
Don't treat /pokaz as a dark theme with its own tokens. It is the same tokens with the planes inverted.
Don't animate anything beyond placement, the night-side slide change, and 160ms colour transitions — and never animate from an invisible default.
Don't load a font over the network; the display face is vendored under public/fonts and the body face is the platform stack.
